summary: Iter 26 — verified (a) React.lazy/Suspense route code-splitting did not break any of the 13 lazy-loaded routes, (b) updated driver fee/earnings copy (100% delivery fee + 100% tips, $0.00 platform deduction, example $17.00) on /driver/earnings, (c) /driver-onboarding driver-rate-highlight badges + /partner partner-rate-highlight badges, (d) backend smoke after adding 93 perf indexes: /api/taxi/rate-card, /api/restaurants, /api/auth/login (admin), /api/admin/stats all 200. 3/3 pytest pass.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js partner-rate-highlight is rendered on the homepage and on /partner (the same App.js section is reused). Verified copy: 'Drivers keep 100% of delivery fees + 100% of tips'. No stale 'up to 90%' / 'subscriber' text.

DriverEarningsDashboard.js feeStructure now: deliveryFeeShare=100, tipShare=100, no serviceFee key. The 'How Your Earnings Work' card shows 'Delivery Fee / Fare 100% Yours', 'Tips 100% Yours', 'Platform Fee Deducted From You $0.00'. Example calc: $12 + $5 - $0.00 = You Earn: $17.00. Mock recent transactions correctly compute Net Earnings = $17.00.

DriverOnboarding.js driver-rate-highlight badges now read 'Keep 100% of every delivery fee' and '100% of your tips', plus helper text 'No platform cut on delivery fees — you keep 100% of every delivery fee and 100% of your tips.' No stale '20% standard' / '10% on delivery' subscriber copy.

Lazy/Suspense: all 13 tested routes (/login, /signup, /restaurants, /car-rentals, /pricing, /partner, /partner/onboarding, /driver-onboarding, /support, /about, /privacy-policy, /terms, /leaderboard) return 200, body length >600, and render successfully. No chunk-load errors in console (only some 403s from background admin requests that fire when admin user lands on certain pages — unrelated to code splitting). /driver-onboarding correctly redirects unauth users to /login and renders the page with badges when logged-in as admin.
Backend: 93 startup indexes did not impact endpoint correctness or response times noticeably. Login + admin/stats round-trip under ~1s.
test_credentials: admin.qa@islandhop-demo.com / AdminQA1234! (user_type=admin) — successfully reached both /driver/earnings and /driver-onboarding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All fee-copy and code-splitting acceptance checks passed end-to-end on the preview URL. Admin reaches /driver/earnings + /driver-onboarding by setting localStorage.token after POST /api/auth/login. /driver-onboarding redirects to /login when unauthed (expected). Background console 403s on /driver/earnings are from admin-only sidebar/stats fetches and are unrelated to the changes in this iteration.
